tagline.zh: Apple Liquid Glass 的声明式 API 面:glassEffect(_:in:) / Glass(variant、tint、interactive) / GlassEffectContainer(spacing) / glassEffectID morph;本条目用 CSS 近似呈现其参数语义。
tagline.en: Apple Liquid Glass' declarative API surface: glassEffect(_:in:) / Glass (variant, tint, interactive) / GlassEffectContainer(spacing) / glassEffectID morphing — presented here as a CSS approximation of the parameter semantics.

origin.zh: Apple SwiftUI/API 文档一手核验(调研 02§A1–A6):glassEffect(_:in:) 默认 .regular、默认形状 Capsule;Glass 结构体含 regular/clear/identity 与 tint(_:)/interactive(_:);GlassEffectContainer init(spacing:content:) 控制融合;HIG Materials 定义 regular/clear 两变体并警示勿用于内容层。
origin.en: Verified firsthand against Apple's SwiftUI/API docs (research 02 §A1–A6): glassEffect(_:in:) defaults to .regular with a Capsule default shape; the Glass struct carries regular/clear/identity plus tint(_:)/interactive(_:); GlassEffectContainer's init(spacing:content:) governs blending; HIG Materials defines the regular/clear variants and warns against content-layer use.

effect.zh: Liquid Glass 官方两变体。regular=模糊背景并调整亮度保文字可读,绝大多数系统组件用它,也是 glassEffect 的官方默认参数(A2);clear=高透,仅用于媒体等丰富背景之上的浮动组件,HIG 明示其上内容偏亮时要加深色 dimming(调研 02§A1、06§16:35% 不透明度暗层)。JS 型参数,demo 切 data-variant。
effect.en: The two official Liquid Glass variants. regular = blurs the backdrop and tunes luminance for legibility, used by most system components and the documented default of glassEffect (A2); clear = highly transparent, reserved for floating controls over rich media, and HIG says to dim it when underlying content is bright (research 02 §A1, 06 §16: a 35%-opacity dark layer). JS-type param toggled via data-variant in the demo.

effect.zh: 着色强度映射。官方 API 是 Glass.tint(_:) / UIGlassEffect.tintColor 接受任意 Color(调研 02§A3/A6),没有数值强度参数——本条目把它映射为固定强调色的叠加不透明度,0=不着色(演示默认);Web 近似,非官方 API 面。
effect.en: Tint-strength mapping. The official APIs Glass.tint(_:) / UIGlassEffect.tintColor accept an arbitrary Color (research 02 §A3/A6) with no numeric-strength parameter — this entry maps tint to the overlay opacity of one fixed accent color, 0 = untinted (demo default); a Web approximation, not the official API surface.

effect.zh: 交互反馈开关,对应 Glass.interactive(_:) 与 UIGlassEffect.isInteractive(调研 02§A3/A6):开启后玻璃对指针/触摸给出发光与按压反馈。off 对应未调用 interactive(_:) 的基础玻璃;默认行为按 API 页为准,demo 用 data-interactive 切换。
effect.en: The interactive-feedback switch, mapping to Glass.interactive(_:) and UIGlassEffect.isInteractive (research 02 §A3/A6): when on, glass gives glow/press feedback to pointer and touch. off corresponds to glass without interactive(_:) applied; treat the API pages as authoritative for defaults. The demo toggles data-interactive.

effect.zh: GlassEffectContainer(spacing:content:) 的形状融合距离:两块玻璃间距小于 spacing 时开始融合 morph(A4 原文:spacing 越大形状越早开始融合)。官方未记载具体默认数值——默认 8 为本条目演示取值;demo 用固定 24px 间距的两块胶囊,spacing 逼近间距时桥接层渐显。
effect.en: The blend distance of GlassEffectContainer(spacing:content:): glass shapes begin blending when closer than spacing (A4 verbatim: larger spacing makes shapes blend earlier). Apple records no numeric default — 8 is this entry's demo value; the demo fixes a 24px gap between two capsules and fades in a liquid bridge as spacing approaches it.

note.zh: glassEffect/GlassEffectContainer 是 iOS 26+/macOS 26+ 等 SwiftUI/UIKit API,不在浏览器中(调研 02§A2–A6);Web demo 用 backdrop-filter + 渐变近似(backdrop-filter:Chrome 76/Firefox 103/Safari 9 带 -webkit- 前缀,BCD 调研 02§D2)。API 可用性矩阵以 Apple 平台版本为准。
note.en: glassEffect/GlassEffectContainer are SwiftUI/UIKit APIs on iOS 26+/macOS 26+ class platforms, not in browsers (research 02 §A2–A6); the Web demo approximates with backdrop-filter plus gradients (backdrop-filter: Chrome 76 / Firefox 103 / Safari 9 with the -webkit- prefix per BCD, research 02 §D2). API availability follows Apple's platform versions.

fallback.zh: Web 近似的玻璃不具备 Liquid Glass 的动态折射/实时亮度调整——交付跨端设计时把变体语义(regular 保读/clear 限媒体)与 spacing 语义作为规格,而非具体渲染值;不支持 backdrop-filter 的浏览器按 glassmorphism 的回退策略提高填充不透明度。
fallback.en: A Web-approximated glass lacks Liquid Glass' dynamic refraction/real-time luminance tuning — when shipping cross-platform, deliver the variant semantics (regular for legibility, clear over media only) and the spacing semantics as the spec, not rendered values; browsers without backdrop-filter follow the glassmorphism fallback of raising fill opacity.

use.zh: iOS 26+/对应平台系统组件的导航栏、标签栏、工具栏(功能层,浮于内容之上)
use.en: Nav bars, tab bars and toolbars of system components on iOS 26+-class platforms (functional layers above content)

use.zh: 照片/视频之上的浮动控件用 clear 变体(内容偏亮时加 35% 暗层)
use.en: Floating controls over photos/video with the clear variant (add the 35% dim layer over bright content)

use.zh: 一组相邻控件需要玻璃间融合 morph:GlassEffectContainer + glassEffectID 匹配身份
use.en: Clusters of adjacent controls blending/morphing: GlassEffectContainer plus glassEffectID identity matching

use.zh: Web 端复刻同类观感:双层胶囊玻璃 + 高透媒体浮层,以本条目参数近似
use.en: Web recreations of the same look: paired capsule glass and high-transparency media overlays approximated by these params

avoid.zh: 内容层(列表正文、表单)套 Liquid Glass——HIG 明示勿用于内容层且勿过度使用
avoid.en: Applying Liquid Glass to content layers (list bodies, forms) — HIG explicitly forbids content-layer use and overuse

avoid.zh: clear 变体放在平色/浅色背景上——高透玻璃在非丰富底上失效(与 glassmorphism 同理)
avoid.en: The clear variant over flat/pale backdrops — high-transparency glass collapses without a rich backdrop (same as glassmorphism)

avoid.zh: 把 Web 近似当成官方渲染——动态折射、scroll edge effect、亮度自适应均无法用静态 CSS 复刻
avoid.en: Treating the Web approximation as official rendering — dynamic refraction, scroll edge effect and luminance adaptation cannot be replicated in static CSS

avoid.zh: 大段文字直接压在 clear 上——保读责任在 regular;clear 的文字对比度要按最亮背景核算
avoid.en: Long text directly on clear — legibility is regular's job; on clear, text contrast must be checked against the brightest backdrop

a11y.zh: 玻璃是功能层材质:其上文字按透出内容的极端明暗核对 4.5:1(WCAG 2.1 SC 1.4.3),clear 变体必须叠暗层或换 regular 才能保读;interactive 反馈不得取代焦点指示(SC 2.4.7);HIG 警示勿让玻璃成为内容层——文字信息的载体永远是内容层本身。
a11y.en: Glass is a functional-layer material: text on it must hold 4.5:1 against the brightest/darkest transmitted content (WCAG 2.1 SC 1.4.3); the clear variant needs the dim layer or a switch to regular to stay legible; interactive feedback never replaces focus indicators (SC 2.4.7); per HIG, glass is never the content layer — text always lives on the content layer itself.

goal.zh: 在照片背景上复刻 Liquid Glass 控件组:两枚胶囊玻璃置于共享玻璃场中(regular/clear 可切,tint 强度、interactive、container spacing 可调),clear 时对亮背景叠 35% 暗层,并注明这是 CSS 近似。
goal.en: Recreate a Liquid Glass control cluster over a photo: two capsule glass shapes inside a shared glass field (regular/clear switchable, tint strength, interactive and container spacing tunable), a 35% dim layer on clear over bright content, annotated as a CSS approximation.

acceptance.zh: 变体语义正确:regular 模糊+调亮度保读;clear 高透且亮背景上叠 35% 暗层(HIG 数值)
acceptance.en: Variant semantics correct: regular blurs + tunes luminance for legibility; clear is high-transparency with the HIG's 35% dark dim layer over bright content

acceptance.zh: 形状用胶囊(官方默认形状 Capsule),两块玻璃间距由 spacing 参数驱动并在逼近时呈现融合桥
acceptance.en: Shapes are capsules (the documented default Capsule), the gap between them driven by spacing, showing a blend bridge as spacing approaches the gap

acceptance.zh: interactive=on 时有可感知的按压/发光反馈,且不取代键盘焦点指示
acceptance.en: With interactive=on there is perceivable press/glow feedback that never replaces the keyboard focus indicator

acceptance.zh: 标注「CSS 近似,非 Liquid Glass 本体」;不模拟折射/滚动边缘效果
acceptance.en: Annotate 'CSS approximation, not Liquid Glass itself'; do not fake refraction or the scroll edge effect
